decision: Reproduce Experiment 1 benchmarks and a separate evaluate-only Experiment 2 runtime study under the confirmed 0818meeting requirements.

confirmed_scope.dgp: Published 50-dimensional Gaussian block design and nonlinear response
metrics: Power(C1 union C2) retained in CSV only
confirmed_scope.cross_fitting: Two-fold KFold with held-out UEIF aggregation
confirmed_scope.inference: Negative-mean threshold, published response-variance floor, one-sided alpha=0.05
confirmed_scope.flow: 3000 auxiliary observations, 15000 training steps, average squared Jacobian
confirmed_scope.figures: CPI and SCPI each use a 2-by-3 AUC, Power(C1), Type-I(C3) layout
confirmed_scope.type1_interpretation: Report empirical C3 Type-I error against nominal alpha without post-hoc forcing

runtime.timing: evaluate-only; exclude shared model fit and OT/EOT/Flow construction or training
runtime.flow_preparation: 5000 steps on an auxiliary sample matching each runtime sample size
runtime.checkpoint: atomic per sample-size x seed x method cell

clarifications: The meeting note about removing very small variances does not apply to this simulation.
Quick mode uses reduced computational settings and is never formal evidence.
DFI-EOT is a JSS extension rather than a method in the original Experiment 1; its existing epsilon remains explicit in code pending a separate sensitivity analysis.
